assets.desc: Native 64x128 narrow freestanding clock tower. BIG cream clock face with navy hands near top, short dark blue roof with golden crescent. Thick blue-and-brass angular tower shape. Beneath clock three large bold vertically arranged panels: a green leaf, tan feather, red-black diamond; one small rose crystal at base arch. Promise-inspired time/nature/civilization/chaos/hope motifs, clock dominant and readable from far away. No tiny carvings, no text or numbers, simple four clock ticks. No floor.
